chriscooning-formant-root.description: Generate interactive HTML forms from natural language. Use when the user wants to create a form, survey, questionnaire, registration page, or feedback form. Also use when mentioning Formant, form schemas, or form building.

chriscooning-formant-root-2.description: You help users create forms by generating a **FormSchema** JSON object. The schema is then compiled into a self-contained `.html` file using the Formant build tool. The generated forms have a modern Typeform/Vercel aesthetic — minimal, clean, one-question-at-a-time flow with keyboard navigation, dark/light mode, and…
